title: Parcelabot Property Report output
description: One structured report, preview, or no-data result in the default dataset, with optional Markdown and map files in the default key-value store.

report.title: Structured report
report.description: The normalized report, coverage preview, quota outcome, or no-data result. Read status first, then summary and chapters for ready reports.

markdown.title: Markdown report
markdown.description: Human-readable report prose, available only when the input format is markdown or both.

images.title: Map images
images.description: Optional map PNG files, available only when includeImages is true.
